title: Adam Sandler shines with daughters at the premiere of Don't Say Good Luck
seoTitle: Adam Sandler on Red Carpet with Daughters
subtitle: At the premiere of "Don't Say Good Luck", the actor hits the red carpet with daughters Sunny and Sadie, while his quirky look steals the spotlight.
excerpt: Adam Sandler arrived on New York's red carpet with daughters Sunny and Sadie, showcasing a colorful look that reignited interest in his personal style.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Adam Sandler appeared Monday night on New York's red carpet alongside his two daughters, Sunny and Sadie, and his wife Jackie, for the Netflix premiere of "Don't Say Good Luck". The actor wore a blue polo with a flamingo print, blue jogger pants, and burgundy sneakers, while Jackie chose a simple-cut black dress.

Adam Sandler and the premiere of “Don't Say Good Luck”

The film, produced by Adam and Jackie, stars Sunny in the lead role as Sophie Birenbaum. The actor's presence at the premiere underscores the family-oriented nature of the production, which features Melanie Lynskey and Max Greenfield.

Sunny and Sadie Sandler steal the show

The daughters drew attention with striking outfits: Sadie wore a black silk dress with wide straps, and Sunny appeared in an emerald‑green dress with silver details that shimmered under the lights. The combination of colors and styles highlighted the night as both a fashion and cinematic event.

Family production and Sunny's casting

Julia Hart, director of the feature, revealed that Sunny was "the first and only person we thought of to play Sophie". In an interview, Hart added: "I knew she would be great, but she exceeded all my expectations as an actress, singer, tireless worker, and amazing leader on set". Sunny herself said: "I knew as soon as I heard the idea that I loved it, believed in it, and wanted to do it" and "Then I met with Julia, and that really made me want to be part of it".

The "Sandlercore" phenomenon and the family's reaction

Adam's relaxed style, known online as "Sandlercore", has once again drawn attention. The actor noted that when his kids or friends comment on his look, "the wife is like, 'What the hell are we talking about now? How did this happen?'" He added that his wife has always supported him: "He's comfortable like that. Let him do it. Leave him alone".

Sunny Sandler makes her television debut

On August 3, Sunny made her television debut on the late‑night show "The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon", where she shared that when they were younger, she and her sister used to dress in their dad's clothes: "Big shirts, shorts. We held Diet Cokes and yelled about the air‑conditioner being off. Then we'd jump into the pool with socks because he wears socks in the pool since he can't bend to take them off on land".

With information from Yahoo.
